bio.body_md:
I'm Monish Kamwal — a Computer Science co-op student at Memorial University of Newfoundland, and an AI developer who builds machine-learning systems end to end.

Most of my work has been in the public sector: government RAG chatbots, the MLOps behind a fleet-management platform, cloud infrastructure that has to actually hold up. What draws me in isn't the model in isolation but everything around it — how data gets versioned, how a bad model gets stopped before it ships, how infrastructure can build itself up for a load test and tear itself back down to nothing.

This site is one of those systems, built from scratch on my own time: the doodle demo on the home page is the friendly face, and the machine behind it — pipelines, quality gates, drift monitoring, an ephemeral Kubernetes cluster — is the real work. Based in St. John's, Newfoundland.

entries.place: Shared Services Canada · St. John's, NL
entries.line: Built a government RAG chatbot and the end-to-end MLOps behind a fleet-management platform on Azure.
details: Engineered an enterprise RAG ingestion pipeline (Azure Functions, Blob Storage, Azure AI Document Intelligence) that crawls and converts multi-format public assets and complex PDFs into structure-aware Markdown.

Tuned vector retrieval with header- and table-aware chunking, Azure OpenAI embeddings, and Azure AI Search vector indexing; productionized GPT-4o/mini inference with Azure AI Foundry prompt guardrails for safe, citation-backed answers.

Owned end-to-end MLOps for Fleet Manager v2 — automated data ingestion, Azure DevOps CI/CD, self-hosted build agents, and an MLflow tracking server — and co-managed the Azure infrastructure, telemetry, and cost monitoring.
Recognized with the Technical Innovator Award (Winter 2026) and Problem Solver Award (Spring 2026); featured on the SSC Gazette and the Government of Canada website.

entries.place: Public Services & Procurement Canada · St. John's, NL
entries.line: Shipped the first Fleet Manager release and set the team's data-cleaning standards.
details: Containerized and deployed the Fleet Manager MVP on Azure VMs with Docker and a Caddy reverse proxy for automated HTTPS/TLS, route isolation, and domain management.
Trained and evaluated baseline scikit-learn models to forecast fuel consumption and vehicle availability for fleet operations.
Authored the C.L.E.A.N. data-preprocessing framework (Pandas, NumPy), standardizing how the team cleaned and structured raw fleet data.
Served as Scrum Master for daily standups, designed Figma wireframes, and led team workshops on Docker and data preprocessing; featured on Memorial University's Gazette.

entries.place: Visual and Analytic Computing (VAC) Lab · Memorial University
entries.line: Co-developed a vision-language model for breast-cancer detection and benchmarked 23+ architectures.
details: Co-developed a vision-language model with faculty and graduate researchers for automated breast-cancer detection and clinical report generation under HIPAA/medical-compliance constraints.
Benchmarked 23+ LLM/multimodal architectures across 8 datasets, weighing parameter scale, inference latency, and diagnostic accuracy to inform model selection.
Fine-tuned and deployed open-source multimodal models with context-window optimization and compression for constrained environments; authored the final research report and CAIR manual.
